IncidentBot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT PAGE — embeddings-service (eu-west-1) high error rate. Pager: eng-oncall primary. Incident ID: INC-2026-457. Pages at 2026-03-14T22:04:16Z. Details: 5xx spike, 30% error rate, p95 latency ~800ms. Runbook: https://redwood.dev/runbooks/embeddings-latency
Mia Chen: taking initial triage, joining bridge in 2m, but heads up I have a dentist appt at 22:30 UTC, might need relief.
Samir Patel: I can swap and take primary from 22:25 UTC for ~4h. @Mia Chen confirm and Opsbot update?
Mia Chen: confirmed, will handoff after warmup. Quick checks: service logs show KV cache eviction bursts. Pasting tail:
```
ERROR kvcache: miss limit exceeded
2026-03-14T22:03:58Z embeddings-processor[pid=234] eviction_count=512
```
Jordan Lee: if it's KV thrash, try bumping kv_cache_size or enabling kv cache prefilling per runbook step 4. Link: https://redwood.dev/runbooks/embeddings-latency#kv-cache
Ravi Kapoor: running the quick mitigation — scaling embeddings-workers to +2 replicas now: `kubectl scale deploy embeddings-processor --replicas=6 -n prod-eu`
Opsbot: scaling command accepted by CI. New replicas coming up, rolling update started.

Jordan Lee: logging action item: file a follow-up ticket to investigate root cause of KV thrash under bursty loads. Assigned to Ravi. Ticket ENG-1214.
